_doc: The laws of each realm (systems/laws.js; the Laws panel ui/actionMenu/laws.js). Each law has options; a realm's law is set on kingdom.laws (saved with the realm). Until a ruler sets one, a realm keeps its old custom: share[option] of realms hold each (a hash of the realm, the same all game). Only the ruler of a realm may change its law: each change costs changeCost.treasury from the crown's treasury and changeCost.stability of the realm's stability (folk dislike upheaval), plus the option's own stability (adopting a hard law costs more), and a law may be changed again only after cooldownDays. Every law is read by the game: privatePrisons by systems/knockout.js (a private citizen may drag the beaten off to their prison camp only where it's allowed); foreignLand by systems/lots.js (where only subjects may hold land, a stranger can't buy a lot or a house, nor rent one); punishment by systems/streetCrime.js (the watch's fines and days in the cells, × fine and × jail).

privatePrisons.name: Private Prisons
privatePrisons.desc: May a private citizen keep a prison camp, and put those they take to work?

forbidden.label: Forbidden
forbidden.desc: Only the crown keeps prisoners. Whoever takes a captive must hand them to the watch.

allowed.label: Allowed
allowed.desc: Free folk may keep prison camps and work their prisoners. Those who set on you may drag you off to theirs.

foreignLand.name: Land for Foreigners
foreignLand.desc: May those not sworn to the realm buy building lots and houses in its towns?

open.label: Open to all
open.desc: Anyone with the coin may buy a lot or a house, or rent one.

subjects.label: Subjects only
subjects.desc: Only those sworn to the realm may buy or rent land and houses in its towns.

punishment.name: Punishment
punishment.desc: How hard the watch comes down on brawlers and worse: the fines and the days in the cells.

lenient.label: Lenient
lenient.desc: Lighter fines, shorter stays in the cells.

standard.label: Customary
standard.desc: The fines and sentences of long custom.

harsh.label: Harsh
harsh.desc: Heavy fines and long sentences. The streets are quieter; the people grumble.
